name: create_preview_link
description: Create a temporary read-only preview of saved Page Builder source, including enabled JavaScript. Anyone with the URL can view this fixed snapshot for 15 minutes without a login. A new link replaces the old link. Does not publish or change page source. Use only for the user-requested page. Standalone rendering does not test theme chrome, server forms or network requests; inspect the static rendering report. Source changes require a new link.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Explicit Page Builder-owned page ID to preview.

output.description: Preview URL, Unix expiry, snapshot digest, source dependencies and static rendering report. Treat the URL as temporary access to draft content.
